THE RULES TRAVEL WITH THE GAME

Clear the skyline.
Keep your balance.

The ball has no gravity. Your pendulum does. Only the cart has a motor, so every return disturbs the paddle you need for the next one.

01 / THE BOARD

15 bricks. 100 points each.

Every First Light brick has one health point. Row colors help you read the board; deeper bricks award the same points. A clear completes after the final contact separates.

02 / THE LIVES

Three chances to stay together.

A missed ball, collapse, rail or court-edge fault, body contact or illegal paddle-face contact costs a life. Removed bricks stay removed. A new life begins with a two-second warmup.

03 / THE CLOCK

120 seconds of simulation.

Clear all fifteen bricks to win. A timeout ends the board without a win. Changing tabs, leaving the window or a slow frame pauses human play; press Resume when you return.

04 / THE MODES

Play is its own lane.

Human assisted and direct play are separate from the autonomous Corben-versus-Marc competition. There is no leaderboard or submitted-bot ranking in this alpha.
